title: Multi-Currency Enhancement - Removed Hardcoded NGN Defaults
description: This update removes all hardcoded Nigerian Naira (NGN) currency defaults and replaces them with dynamic base currency lookups, ensuring true multi-currency support for global users.

changes.description: Removed hardcoded NGN fallback in User::getPreferredCurrency()
changes.impact: Users without a set currency now default to the admin's chosen base currency instead of NGN

changes.description: Removed hardcoded NGN fallback in Admin::getPreferredCurrency()
changes.impact: Admins without a set currency now default to the system's base currency

changes.description: Updated PaystackController to use dynamic base currency
changes.impact: Payment currency defaults now respect the admin's base currency setting

changes.description: Updated FlutterwaveController to use dynamic base currency
changes.impact: Payment processing now uses the correct base currency instead of assuming NGN

changes.description: Fixed CurrencyController::formatAmountForUser() to use base currency
changes.impact: Amount formatting now respects the system's configured base currency

changes.description: Updated minimum deposit calculation to be exchange-rate based
changes.impact: Minimum deposit amounts are now calculated proportionally for all currencies instead of using hardcoded values

upgrade_notes: This update will automatically apply. No manual configuration needed. Your existing base currency settings will be respected.
